summary: The route has mandatory interaction and enemy gates that should not be mistaken for optional enemy-forces choices.
actions: Activate every totem in the opening area to unlock progress toward Rav'i.
Defeat the Ascendant Serpent after the Writhing Coil to continue.
Use crowd control to stop High Evolutionists channeling Evolve; a completed channel heals and grants a shield with crowd-control immunity.

provenance.description: Original compact route summary derived from targeted review of Wowhead's Patch 12.1 Altar of Fangs overview and Evolve spell record.
